main_protocol.coordinate_normalization: fixed enclosing-circle diameter, invariant under reference rotation
main_protocol.spatial_domain: entire supplied rectangle; cell centers; bilinear interpolation
main_protocol.feature_definition: join-tree leaf plus regular vertices on its incident arc, not a cyclone basin
main_protocol.topology_signature: leaf extrema and branching merge levels; unary root extension contracted; scalar levels rounded to 1e-7 hPa
main_protocol.correspondence: maximum intersection-count Hungarian assignment, positive overlap only; shared by ST-MTM, RA-MTM and metrics
